channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: US, Iran have launched multiple attacks during ceasefire: A timeline
item.description: Washington carried out new strikes on southern Iran, while Tehran downed a US drone and fired at a fighter jet.

item.title: US strike on alleged drug boat in Pacific kills one
item.description: Dozens of attacks since September have killed at least 194 people in US operation dubbed 'Southern Spear'.

item.title: Israel claims head of Hamas military wing killed in Gaza strike
item.description: There was no immediate response from the Palestinian group after Israel claimed Mohammed Odeh killed.

item.title: Israeli strike in Gaza City kills new head of Hamas's military wing
item.description: At least three people were killed in the attack, which came despite a ceasefire with Hamas being in place.

item.title: Dozens killed in Lebanon as Israel intensifies strikes
item.description: Israel says it struck 100 Hezbollah infrastructure sites and fighters in Lebanon, after PM Benjamin Netanyahu vows to "crush" the Iran-backed group.

item.title: One killed and nine missing after chemical explosion at US paper mill
item.description: Nine others were injured and another nine are missing after a tank ruptured at a paper mill in Longview, Washington.

item.title: Iran condemns US strikes as 'gross violation' of ceasefire
item.description: The attacks took place while Iranian and Qatari negotiators were in Doha for peace talks.
